overloads.semanticRole: Returns an object describing the given standard action's current availability/status (enabled, visible, checked/unchecked/mixed, title, current parameter value) in the specified form context.

constraints: action can be a plain action-name string or a constant from the Standard Action theme; some actions require the 'name?param=value' pattern (e.g. "gotoPage?value=2").
If target is omitted, the ak current form context is used by default.
Returns null (undefined) if the action's status cannot be determined (e.g. not attached to any object or menu command).

Returns an object with these properties: enabled (Boolean, true if the action can be invoked); status (Text, one of "checked"/"unchecked"/"mixed" -- e.g. for ak font bold, "checked" means the selection is bold, "unchecked" means it isn't, "mixed" means only part of the selection is); title (Text, current localized action label, e.g. "Undo"); visible (Boolean, true if the action is visible in the form); value (Text, current value of the action's parameter string, if any, e.g. "10pt" for "fontSize?value=10pt"). The parameter table's Function-result row instead lists boolean properties isEnabled/isVisible/isChecked/isMixed/isUnknownState; that table entry is a documentation error/stale summary -- the properties above (enabled/status/title/visible/value, from the Description section prose) are the correct, authoritative shape.
